description: This bar chart illustrates the GLUE Performance for two RoBERTa model sizes—base (blue) and large (orange)—across seven different fine-tuning methods: Prefix, Adaptor, LoRA, BitFit, S₁-model, S₄-model, and S₅-model. The horizontal axis, labeled “Fine-tuning Method,” lists these methods in order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “GLUE Performance,” is scaled linearly from approximately 85 to 89, with tick marks at intervals of 1. Each method is represented by a pair of adjacent bars: a blue bar for the base model and an orange bar for the large model. The chart shows that for most methods, the large model outperforms the base model, with the most significant performance difference observed in the LoRA method, where the large model achieves a score of approximately 88.5 and the base model scores around 87. The S₅-model also shows a strong performance for the large model, reaching nearly 89, while the base model for the same method scores around 87.5. The BitFit method shows a stark contrast, with the base model performing very poorly (around 85.2) compared to the large model (around 87.8). The S₁-model shows nearly identical performance for both model sizes, around 85.5. The chart does not include the S₀-model or S₃-model mentioned in the caption, as they are not plotted. The bars are not sorted, and no visual emphasis is applied to any specific bar beyond the color-coding in the legend.
